resources.string: Observes app changes, typing, taps, and scrolling. After consent, the visible screen can be captured during a desktop dashboard run. ML Kit reads text locally after keyboard masking. Screenshot images stay in memory. Run events and extracted text are saved on your connected computer through ADB. In debug builds with a development key, extracted text goes to TypeSafe for Jev analysis. Any of the six checks at 0.7 or higher flags the capture as probably scam.
